scope: One proposed bounded spatial predictor, internally transport/Ours-5. Standalone actual-PDF review; final manuscript integration will be reviewed separately. No training, source model, prior results or original figures modified.
model_contract_checks: Exactly three observed grids; no future image enters the model.
Spatially averaged encoded support and past actions supply one transition context; future commands enter only the causal prefix GRU/predictor.
Repeated H_h ports identify the same 16 by 96 state; E_0 is the fixed last observed spatial encoding BEFORE FiLM.
T_h=softmax_row(Q_h K_0^T / sqrt(96) + 4I): identity bias is outside the scale, normalization is row-wise.
Z_0 is the shared per-channel training-normalized last observed 16 by 384 grid, fixed at all forecast horizons.
Per-patch affine sigmoid gate broadcasts over channels; complementary coefficients form (1-g)Z_0 + g(T_h Z_0).
Residual is projected from H_h before tanh; the unit-bounded innovation is added after the anchor blend.
Diagram represents features, not RGB generation, physical-flow estimates or a tested CEM controller.
Encoder freezing and offline trainable modules are differentiated without labeling parameter-free operations trainable.
resolved_findings: Added patch-mean label to the encoded support/context branch.
Caption defines fixed normalized Z_0, pre-FiLM E_0 and shared H_h aliases.
Replaced overbroad solid/green trainability legend with dashed frozen-encoder legend.
